subject.title: [Feature]: Add Baseten Model API provider support

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Baseten as an official external provider plugin, including Inkling as its recommended onboarding model and narrow core catalog and documentation integration?
rationale: The implementation boundary is established, but official publisher status, recommended defaults, fallback-catalog maintenance, and core promotion require explicit product and ownership intent.

options.title: Sponsor official plugin
options.body: Approve an externally maintained Baseten provider package with named ownership, live API validation, and narrow official catalog and documentation integration.

options.title: Community plugin only
options.body: Publish the provider through ClawHub and npm without official catalog status or an OpenClaw-recommended default.

options.title: Defer support
options.body: Keep Baseten on generic custom-provider configuration until ownership or demand becomes clearer.

recommendation.title: Sponsor official plugin
recommendation.body: Approve an externally maintained Baseten provider package with named ownership, live API validation, and narrow official catalog and documentation integration.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to provider architecture, hosted-provider additions, and the vision rules governing official plugin promotion.
